from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FilingCashEntry(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash information from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant/company name identified in the document")
    cash_line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label for the cash balance (e.g., 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    cash_amount_value: str | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported for cash, as written in the document (e.g., '120,303')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency symbol or name associated with the amount")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for this financial data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    filings: list[FilingCashEntry]
